snippet.title: Looters - Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Looters is a couch co-op goblin heist for 2 players. Sneak, stack, and steal your way through a guarded manor packed with enemies, secrets, and loot. Take everything… and get out alive.

Wishlist Looters on Steam now!
